 On the 4th at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was held.
 With KT having beaten Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the previous day, Game 2 features a starting matchup between KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Paddack.
 With two outs and no runners in the bottom of the second, on a pop fly by KT's Han Seung-taek, Samsung starter Paddack is committing an error by misplaying the ball. Nov. 4, 2026
